environment.description: ECS Fargate task in isolated subnet. The FULFILLMENT_ORIGIN_URL is a CloudFront distribution (https://d1abc2def3ghij.cloudfront.net) configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) and a custom origin (the internal ALB accessible only via CloudFront's managed prefix list in the ALB security group). CloudFront distribution has a cache behavior requiring signed URLs with a Trusted Key Group (key group kg-9f8e7d6c5b). The CloudFront distribution also has a Response Headers Policy and a custom Origin Request Policy that strips all headers except Content-Type, X-Internal-Service, and X-Amz-Cf-Id before forwarding to origin. The ECS task does NOT have access to the CloudFront signing private key — signed URLs are generated by a separate Lambda authorizer and passed as pre-signed paths with 30-second TTL. Without a valid signature, CloudFront returns 403. Additionally, the ALB security group ingress only allows the com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing managed prefix list on port 443.

config.network: Isolated subnet, no direct route to ALB

cloudfront_distribution.origin_request_policy: Custom: whitelist Content-Type, X-Internal-Service, X-Amz-Cf-Id only

alb_security_group.ingress: Allow TCP 443 from com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing prefix list ONLY

config.signing_mechanism: Lambda authorizer generates signed URLs with 30s TTL, ECS task has no access to private key
